metadata.name: library-gallery
metadata.description: Stage-4 Library journey driving the outputs gallery end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /library and asserts the gallery composes — the root and the filter input render, which proves the surface derives its grid from JobsService.ListJobs (the Stage-4 contract decision: outputs come from succeeded jobs, with no separate outputs backend) without crashing. On a fresh scenario with no prior outputs the empty state renders; once jobs exist the grid renders with thumbnails. A Library that fails to compose, a broken ListJobs derivation, or a crash on empty data all fail here. Grid rendering, multi-select bulk-download, and reopen-in-Workspace are unit-covered by LibraryView.test; the reopen handoff shares the workspaceIntent path proven by home-launchpad.

assert.failure_message: Library filter input not visible — the Library surface failed to compose (check LibraryView mounts and the ListJobs query is wired through ui/src/api/jobs.ts).

metadata.label: Assert the Library composed and derives from ListJobs
